home.title: MCP servers for any website
home.subtitle: raidr crawls a site, reads the JavaScript it ships, and turns the APIs it calls into a hosted MCP server plus an agent skill that explains how to get a token. Bring your own login; the tools do the rest.
home.how1: Pick an API host. Its page lists every tool and the request each one makes.
home.how2: Open the matching skill to see exactly where to copy your token from after logging in to the site.
home.how3: Add the endpoint to your MCP client with the token in the X-Raidr-Token header.

mcp.skillTitle: A skill explains how to get a token for this API

connect.intro: Add the hosted endpoint to your MCP client with two headers: your raidr API key, and your own token for the site. raidr forwards the site token to the upstream API on every call and never stores either.
connect.noAuth: This API needs no site token.

skill.installOne: Run this once, then start a new Claude Code session. The first time the skill runs it asks for your raidr API key and saves it to ~/.raidr/config.json.

api.signInTitle: Sign in to browse and try the endpoints
api.signInDescription: Endpoint documentation and the request playground are available to signed-in users. It is free to sign up.
api.flowSubtitle: Which calls supply the data (ids, tokens) other calls need. Hover a tile to trace its flow; click it to open it.

guide.devtools: In that window, open the developer tools:
guide.safari: Safari: first turn on Settings › Advanced › "Show features for web developers".
guide.cookieTab: Open the Application tab (Firefox and Safari: Storage). It may hide behind the » arrow.
guide.cookieList: In the left column, open Cookies and click the {{site}} entry.
guide.cookieCopy: , double-click its Value and copy it (⌘C / Ctrl+C).
guide.network: Click the Network tab, then reload the page (⌘R / Ctrl+R) so its requests appear.
guide.filter: Type this into the filter box at the top of the list:
guide.pick: Click any request in the list. In the panel that opens, choose Headers and scroll to Request Headers.
guide.copyAfter: — copy everything after "{{prefix}}" (right-click the value › Copy value, then delete the "{{prefix}}" at the start).
guide.copyAll: — copy its whole value (right-click › Copy value).
guide.noHeader: No such line? Click another request: not every call carries it. Still none means you are not signed in yet.
guide.title: How to copy your token by hand
guide.signIn: Click "Sign in to {{site}}" above and sign in. If you are already signed in there, the site just opens on your account.
guide.paste: Paste it into the field below. That is all.
guide.safety: This token is your signed-in session on {{site}}: treat it like a password and paste it only here. Tokens expire; if Execute starts answering 401, get a fresh one the same way.
